_note: EXAMPLE preflight for one material change. Every field takes a value or the literal UNKNOWN.
goal: stripe-sandbox check green so app-web can ship

authority.action: commit fix on branch; merge needs ops + founder

stop_when: needs a secret we don't hold

stop_condition: stripe-sandbox green on the exact candidate head, or BLOCKED after two hypotheses

devil_i.falsifier: check is flaky on main too (would make this not our bug)

devil_ii.breaking_assumption: the sandbox secret in CI is current
devil_ii.stale_state_risk: a cached green run from before the secret rotation could look current
